resolved.reason: Generic schedule does not identify the plant or sun stress and fails to reduce sun. A fixed fortnightly schedule may be inappropriate but existing moisture/light details do not establish likely serious damage from this instruction alone.

harmfulness.reason: “Water every two weeks” lacks a soil/pot-weight check, and fertilizer strength is unspecified. This may worsen drought or wetness depending on conditions, though no clearly destructive treatment is proposed.

specificity_accuracy.reason: “They hold lots of water” does not identify this Goeppertia or explain direct-sun damage. “Good light” does not supply the confirmed move out of sun.

feasibility.reason: The frequency is easy to follow, but bottom-watering duration, fertilizer strength and “good light” remain undefined. The user would need further instructions to apply the advice reliably.
